rows: Pa-ro-hon ha-ra-ja-on-Mi, sa-ha-la-mi-do i,
Di-ba-hen i, o Je-sus-ki, ndang ja-di sun-dat i
A-lai i-ang-go e-me i, ndang o-lo mar-par-bu-e i, i-ang-go so na ma-te i di na-bu-ni di ta-no i; Deng-gan do i, di-baen na ma-te i.

verses: Parohon harajaonMi, sahala mido i,
Dibahen i, o Jesuski, ndang jadi sundat i
Alai ianggo eme i, ndang olo marparbue i,
Ianggo so na mate i di nabuni di tano i;
Denggan do i, dibaen na mate i.
O Jesus, ndada sahat Ho tu hasangaponMi,
Tung sura na manjua Ho, manaon na porsuk i,
Sai jalo hami on sude, tu harajaonMi muse:
Ndang na manjua hami on, maniru Ho di tano on.
Pabongot pe tu surgo hami be!
Naung mate Ho di tano, sobokhon eme i,
Sondangi ma portibi on na sahat di Ho i,
Sai suru angka naposoM, mangaliati tano on,
Mamaritahon hataMi: Sai naeng tumpahannami i,
Manumpak be do hami on sude.
title: Parohon harajaonMi

r: O Je-sus, nda-da sa-hat Ho tu ha-sa-nga-pon-Mi,
Tung su-ra na man-ju-a Ho, ma-naon na por-suk i,
Sai ja-lo ha-mi on su-de, tu ha-ra-ja-on-Mi mu-se: Ndang na man-ju-a ha-mi on, ma-ni-ru Ho di ta-no on. Pa-bo-ngot pe tu sur-go ha-mi be!
Na-ung ma-te Ho di ta-no, so-bo-khon e-me i,
Son-da-ngi ma por-ti-bi on na sa-hat di Ho i,
Sai su-ru ang-ka na-po-soM, ma-nga-li-a-ti ta-no on, Ma-ma-ri-ta-hon ha-ta-Mi: Sai naeng tum-pa-han-na-mi i, Ma-num-pak be do ha-mi on su-de.

rows: Ba-tang aek u-se-ho-non-ku, Nin-na De-ba-tan-ta i; Ing-kon bor-nok ba-he-non-ku ia-no na ma-hi-ang i. Par-hor-si-han sa-su-de ing-kon ga-be por-lak be.

verses: Batang aek usehononku, Ninna Debatanta i;
Ingkon bornok bahenonku iano na mahiang i.
Parhorsihan sasude ingkon gabe porlak be.
Sai lambas dope na hasang ala hona toru i;
Israel dope na jalang sian Mesiasna i,
Nang sipelebegu pe na mansai torop dope.
Ingkon jumpang do hataNa, ai burju do Tuhan i;
Ingkon saut inarbagaNa naeng sangap goarNa i.
Ingkon do tandaon ni, nasa bangso Tuhan i.
Ala ni ringgas ma hita mangarahon dongan i;
Tapaborhat ma Pandita tu sude na lili i,
Asa bongotanna be, hasonangan i muse.
Nang leleng so marparbue, n tahalojahon i,
Unang olo be mandele hita na porsea i;
Na marhabengeton i do dapotan tumpal i.
Sai tangihon, ale Jesus, pangidoannami on,
Sangkapnami ma patulus; Gok ma baen portibi on
Dohot hasangaponMi; Sai pararat hataMi!
title: Batang aek usehononku
status: Lirik dicek · 13/18 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Sai lam-bas do-pe na ha-sang a-la ho-na to-ru i; Is-ra-el do-pe na ja-lang si-an Me-si-as-na i, Nang si-pe-le-be-gu pe na man-sai to-rop do-pe.
Ing-kon jum-pang do ha-ta-Na, ai bur-ju do Tu-han i; Ing-kon saut i-nar-ba-ga-Na naeng sa-ngap go-ar-Na i. Ing-kon do tan-da-on ni, na-sa bang-so Tu-han i.
A-la ni ring-gas ma hi-ta ma-nga-ra-hon do-ngan i; Ta-pa-bor-hat ma Pan-di-ta tu su-de na li-li i, A-sa bo-ngo-tan-na be, ha-so-na-ngan i mu-se.
Nang le-leng so mar-par-bu-e, n ta-ha-lo-ja-hon i, U-nang o-lo be man-de-le hi-ta na por-se-a i; Na mar-ha-be-nge-ton i do da-po-tan tum-pal i.
Sai ta-ngi-hon, a-le Je-sus, pa-ngi-do-an-na-mi on, Sang-kap-na-mi ma pa-tu-lus; Gok ma baen por-ti-bi on Do-hot ha-sa-nga-pon-Mi; Sai pa-ra-rat ha-ta-Mi!

rows: Ang-gi-at a-pi-Mi ma-ga-lak, par-ho-long ro-ha si-tu-tu,
Hu-hut ti-bu di-bo-to ha-lak, Ho, Je-sus, ra-ja na tu-tu.
Ai a-tik pe ma-mung-ka to-rang di pur-ba, di pas-ti-ma-po, laos tong go-dang do-pe na hu-rang, Ai naeng ti-ur do sa-su-de.

verses: Anggiat apiMi magalak, parholong roha situtu,
Huhut tibu diboto halak, Ho, Jesus, raja na tutu.
Ai atik pe mamungka torang di purba, di pastimapo,
Laos tong godang dope na hurang, Ai naeng tiur do sasude.
Dibahen i palas, pangolu, patiur liat tano on.
Papatar ma diriM, parngolu, pardame tu portibi on.
Disi ma halak, sasudena, mamuji asi ni rohaM;
Huhut marsinggang ma sudena, sumomba Ho di habangsaM.
Sungguli, baen ias, pasada, luhutna halak Kristen i;
Unang adong bo nanggo sada, na so tumanda asiMi
Dibahen i padomu hami, marhitehite TondiMi.
Sondangi dohot dongannami na so tumanda goaMi.
title: Maribak langit
status: Lirik dicek · 8/12 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Di-ba-hen i pa-las, pa-ngo-lu, pa-ti-ur li-at ta-no on.
Pa-pa-tar ma di-riM, par-ngo-lu, par-da-me tu por-ti-bi on.
Di-si ma ha-lak, sa-su-de-na, ma-mu-ji a-si ni ro-haM; Hu-hut mar-sing-gang ma su-de-na, su-mom-ba Ho di ha-bang-saM.
Sung-gu-li, baen i-as, pa-sa-da, lu-hut-na ha-lak Kris-ten i;
U-nang a-dong bo nang-go sa-da, na so tu-man-da a-si-Mi
Di-ba-hen i pa-do-mu ha-mi, mar-hi-te-hi-te Ton-di-Mi. Son-da-ngi do-hot do-ngan-na-mi na so tu-man-da go-a-Mi.

rows: O Ton-di na mang-go-hi ro-ha Ni pa-nin-da-ngi na par-jo-lo i,
Na so dung o-lo mar-na-lo-ja ma-nga-lo mu-su ni Tu-han-na i.
Sung-gu-li do-hot ro-ha-na-mi on, ma-ma-ti-ta-hon Je-sus i tong-tong

verses: O Tondi na manggohi roha Ni panindangi na parjolo i,
Na so dung olo marnaloja mangalo musu ni Tuhanna i.
Sungguli dohot rohanami on, mamatitahon Jesus i tongtong
Anggiat apiMi ma galak marlojong tu saluhut bangso i!
Jahowa, sai paborhat halak, na burju mangkatahon hataMi.
Sai tatap lambas ni gotilon i. ianggo naposoM otik do i.
AnakMu do na mangajarhon, tu hami hata pangidoan i.
Torop do na mangkaringgashon, mangaradoti na nidokNa i.
Dibahen i tangihon namai, sai dok ma: Amen, saut ma hata i
Antong torop ma baen Pandita, na sai tongtong digohi TondiMi,
Huhut na ringgas marjamita, Manogu halak tu gomgomanMi.
Taluhon ma si bolis i tongtong, pararat ma hataM di tano on.
Urupi hami sian Sion, sai suru Tondi Parbadia i.
Lao paluahon hajolmaon, hombar tu na pinarbagahonMi.
Sondangi ma sandok portibi on, pasiat ma hataM di tano on.
Sai loas ma hatop mardalan, HataM, maanggohi liat tano on.
Naeng songon na marhabanhaban, parbegu masuk tu huriaMon.
Sungguli dohot Israel sude ro mandapothon huriaM muse!
Pauli Sion na marumpak, padao na tau mangambat hataMi;
O Tondi, ro ma Ho manumpak, ulaon ni sude naposoMi.
Tongtong paias porlak anggurMi, ai naeng ramos do parbuena i.
Sai tatap nasa parguruan, inganan ni TondiM ma baen sude;
Lopokkon hata hangoluan tu roha ni parguru i sude
Sai lehon guru angka na burju, parroha pangondian situtu.
title: Naeng pujionku Ho Jahowa
status: Lirik dicek · 19/24 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Ang-gi-at a-pi-Mi ma ga-lak mar-lo-jong tu sa-lu-hut bang-so i!
Ja-ho-wa, sai pa-bor-hat ha-lak, na bur-ju mang-ka-ta-hon ha-ta-Mi.
Sai ta-tap lam-bas ni go-ti-lon i. i-ang-go na-po-soM o-tik do i.
A-nak-Mu do na ma-nga-jar-hon, tu ha-mi ha-ta pa-ngi-do-an i.
To-rop do na mang-ka-ring-gas-hon, ma-nga-ra-do-ti na ni-dok-Na i.
Di-ba-hen i ta-ngi-hon na-ma-i, sai dok ma: A-men, saut ma ha-ta i
An-tong to-rop ma baen Pan-di-ta, na sai tong-tong di-go-hi Ton-di-Mi,
Hu-hut na ring-gas mar-ja-mi-ta, Ma-no-gu ha-lak tu gom-go-man-Mi.
Ta-lu-hon ma si bo-lis i tong-tong, pa-ra-rat ma ha-taM di ta-no on.
U-ru-pi ha-mi si-an Si-on, sai su-ru Ton-di Par-ba-di-a i.
Lao pa-lu-a-hon ha-jol-ma-on, hom-bar tu na pi-nar-ba-ga-hon-Mi.
Son-da-ngi ma san-dok por-ti-bi on, pa-si-at ma ha-taM di ta-no on.
Sai lo-as ma ha-top mar-da-lan, Ha-taM, maang-go-hi li-at ta-no on.
Naeng so-ngon na mar-ha-ban-ha-ban, par-be-gu ma-suk tu hu-ri-a-Mon.
Sung-gu-li do-hot Is-ra-el su-de ro man-da-pot-hon hu-ri-aM mu-se!
Pau-li Si-on na ma-rum-pak, pa-da-o na tau ma-ngam-bat ha-ta-Mi;
O Ton-di, ro ma Ho ma-num-pak, u-la-on ni su-de na-po-so-Mi.
Tong-tong pa-i-as por-lak ang-gur-Mi, ai naeng ra-mos do par-bu-e-na i.
Sai ta-tap na-sa par-gu-ru-an, i-nga-nan ni Ton-diM ma baen su-de;
Lo-pok-kon ha-ta ha-ngo-lu-an tu ro-ha ni par-gu-ru i su-de
Sai le-hon gu-ru ang-ka na bur-ju, par-ro-ha pa-ngon-di-an si-tu-tu.

Je-sus, ro ma Ho pa-ti-bu man-das-da-si ang-ka i

Jesus, ro ma Ho patibu mandasdasi angka i

Togu nasa manisia tu padanMu na badia.
Lam patorop partonaan angka guru na burju
Na mamboan haluaan sian dosa i tutu
Sai pasonggop TondiMi tu sude naposoMi

Hami na pinarmahanMu, ale Tuhan, tatap ma
Sai paringgas ma manogu jolma i tu Debata

Monogihon angka dongan tu lambungMu, ale Tuhan.

r: Lam pa-to-rop par-to-na-an ang-ka gu-ru na bur-ju

Sai pa-song-gop Ton-di-Mi tu su-de na-po-so-Mi A-sa lam to-rop par-be-gu tu na ti-ur i di-to-gu
Ha-mi na pi-nar-ma-han-Mu, a-le Tu-han, ta-tap ma
Sai pa-ring-gas ma ma-no-gu jol-ma i tu De-ba-ta
Sai pa-gan-da ho-long ni ro-ha-na-mi sa-su-de, Mo-no-gi-hon ang-ka do-ngan tu lam-bung-Mu, a-le Tu-han.

Na pa-so-nang sai tong-tong ro-ha na je-a-an:
Mo-lo ji-na-lo-na i, Ga-be na por-se-a Di Tu-han-ta Je-sus i, Si-pa-ba-li je-a

verses: Nunga ro tu hita on hata hangoluan.
Na pasonang sai tongtong roha na jeaan:
Molo jinalona i, Gabe na porsea
Di Tuhanta Jesus i, Sipabali jea
Ala nii tapuji ma, goar ni Tuhanta; Tapasangap Debata,
Na palas rohanta. Mamestahon ari on, ari parningotan
DibasaNa na tongtong, so marpansohotan.

Ipe halomohon ma, endeendenami, sangap ma di goarMi
Dohot di AnakMu, Jesus Sipartogi i tu harajaonMu.
Tuhan, nang tu jolo on tatap hajolmaon.

Sai mar-lo-jong si-tu-tu baen ha-taM tu ha-jol-ma-on,
A-sa ha-ru jum-pang i na ni-dok ni ha-ta-Mi!

rows: Gir-gir ma ha-mu ma-no-gu su-de, na hum na be-gu, man-ju-a do-pe di ha-ta ni Je-sus, na sa-ngap tong-tong. Sang-kap-na pa-tu-lus di por-ti-bi on.

verses: Girgir ma hamu manogu sude, na hum na begu, manjua dope
Di hata ni Jesus, na sangap tongtong. Sangkapna patulus di portibi on.
Ndang jadi hamu, mabiar, ale, sai pangke burju, gogom sasude!
Nang hehe sibolis! Mamolgak hamu, sai tatap ma Jesus pargogo tutu.
Radoti burju hataNa sude, sai monang hamu baenonNa muse.
Ibana do raja na tong monang i, torop pe alona sumurut do i.
Asi ma rohaM, ale Debata! Pasaut ma hataM, tumpahi nama
Sude na niula ni naposoMi; Sai baen ma martua sude jolma pe!
title: Girgir ma hamu
status: Lirik dicek · 7/8 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Ndang ja-di ha-mu, ma-bi-ar, a-le, sai pang-ke bur-ju, go-gom sa-su-de! Nang he-he si-bo-lis! Ma-mol-gak ha-mu, sai ta-tap ma Je-sus par-go-go tu-tu.
Ra-do-ti bur-ju ha-ta-Na su-de, sai mo-nang ha-mu bae-non-Na mu-se. I-ba-na do ra-ja na tong mo-nang i, to-rop pe a-lo-na su-mu-rut do i.
A-si ma ro-haM, a-le De-ba-ta! Pa-saut ma ha-taM, tum-pa-hi na-ma Su-de na ni-u-la ni na-po-so-Mi; Sai baen ma mar-tu-a su-de jol-ma pe!
